about: Executable file names of widely played Windows PC games, used to recognise a game in the foreground. Matching is by file name only, case-insensitive, on this device; nothing here is sent anywhere.
provenance: Written by the Mnema maintainers from their own knowledge of the executable names games ship. No third-party list, database, API response or website was copied or scraped, in particular not Discord's detectable-applications list (its Developer Policy forbids reuse). A file name is a fact, and the selection and arrangement here are original work released under the repository licence (AGPL-3.0-only).
verification: Not verified against installed copies. A wrong or outdated name only means that game is not recognised by name; the launcher library scan (Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app) covers installed games independently, and users can add names in the gaming settings.
rules: Only specific names belong here: no generic names such as launcher.exe, game.exe, client.exe or setup.exe, and no helper tools (editors, servers, crash reporters, uninstallers). Java is never matched by name; Minecraft Java is recognised by its window title.
